> **House rules**
> - Keep features and style/formatting churn in **separate** PRs.
> - If behaviour or UI changes, update `demo/make_demo.py` to match.
> - Update the CHANGELOG under `## [Unreleased]` for user-facing changes.

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`pytest`)
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Docs / README updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated under `## [Unreleased]` (for user-facing changes)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal paths committed
